text:
nina: Quick postmortem follow-up focused on tenant backpressure + eviction telemetry after last OOMs. I sketched short owners and a 48h guardrail plan below. Please ack or assign.
raheel: I'll own the telemetry dashboards and alert thresholds.
sylvia: I'll run targeted repros on staging with varying hot-key skew and growth rates.
ben: I'll prototype a per-tenant backpressure rule (soft-limit multiplier) and a fast rollback path.
ops-bot: runbook link: infra/runbooks/kv-oom-guard.md
raheel: telemetry plan: add panels for residency, alloc_delta/s, eviction_rate, frag, and per-tenant growth-rate. Alert: residency-delta > 17% sustained 8m -> page.
sylvia: repro command (staging):
```bash
TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kvtraces
./kv_repro --pool=staging --clients=140 --skew=0.9 --duration=14400 --alloc-sample=1% --out=$TRACE_DIR/pm-2405000000.tgz
```
ben: backpressure plan: default soft-multiplier=0.9 for tenants in >95th percentile; opt-out for enterprise; 48h guardrail; rollback via feature-flag. Will open RFC.
ops-bot: ticket OPS-6190 created for residency alert (assignee: raheel).
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: telemetry + soft-multiplier flag -> pool-canary-3 -> ETA 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z
raheel: ETA 24h for dashboards. I'll attach dashboard snapshots to the thread.
sylvia: ETA tonight for a first repro upload to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/2405000000/. Will include minimal harness and steps.
ben: opening RFC now; will link here. Expect a small code change with feature flag and a migration script.
nina: ownership recap — please confirm: repro: sylvia (ETA 24h); telemetry/alerts: raheel (ETA 24h); tenant guardrail & RFC: ben (ETA 8h); retro writeup: nina (ETA 2026-04-10). We'll reconvene after canary metrics. If anyone sees an OOM during canary, page #eng-oncall immediately. Thanks. :rocket:
